p: Torre Escénica del Embarcadero de Cancún
Blvd. Kukulcan Km. 4.5, Kukulcan Boulevard, Zona Hotelera
80-m tower with a rotating observation deck that takes about 30 minutes for a full revolution.
Shows and dinner on a pirate boat.
Yacht rentals for exploring all areas of Cancún, snorkeling, diving, swimming the other water activities in your own private yacht. Powerboats, catamarans, and mega yachts available.
Professional PADI certified scuba diving company provides PADI Diving certifications.
